correctness.rationale: PASS: With positive a,b,c,d and circle w=0^a1^b0^c1^d, a mixed square XX of length <=n has 3 or 4 letter transitions, forcing a conjugate of a two-run root. Four possible 3-transition forms with explicit necessary/sufficient containment inequalities, plus split forms at b=d or a=c with min(a,c)-1 and min(b,d)-1 distinct 4-transition words, give mixed count M=a+b if both pairs equal, min(b,d)+1 if a=c alone, min(a,c)+1 if b=d alone, else 1. Pure-letter squares contribute floor(max(a,c)/2)+floor(max(b,d)/2). A separate parity and run-length bound plus explicit attaining quadruples yields sharp H4(4)=2, H4(n)=floor(3n/4)-1 for n>=7 congruent 3 mod4 and floor(3n/4) otherwise. Fresh literal cyclic-square enumeration tested all 1,820 positive quadruples with n=4..16, every formula and all length maxima matched. The proof case analysis, not finite tests, covers all positive run lengths.
